source_document: Feston / Deye Hybrid & String Inverter User Manual & DeyeCloud / SolarOS Fault Protocol

F18.title: AC Overcurrent Fault
F18.description: Inverter output AC current exceeded hardware safety limit.
F18.oem_definition: AC OverCurrent Fault F18. Hardware circuit detected instantaneous or sustained inverter AC output current exceeding safety limits.
potential_causes: Sudden heavy load connection or short circuit on AC distribution
Grid voltage surge or phase fluctuation
Inverter internal IGBT module or sensor failure
F18.recommended_action: Check AC breaker and distribution load. Inspect inverter AC output terminals and restart after checking line impedance.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Isolate AC breaker and DC isolator switches. Wait 5 minutes for bus capacitors to discharge.
Check AC wiring terminals for loose connections, burnt marks, or line-to-line shorts.
Measure AC line impedance and grid voltage before re-energizing inverter.

F20.title: DC Overcurrent Fault
F20.description: DC input current on PV or battery port exceeded allowable hardware limit.
F20.oem_definition: DC OverCurrent Fault F20. Hardware sensor detected excessive DC current on MPPT or battery inputs.
potential_causes: PV string over-sizing beyond inverter MPPT current specification
Short circuit on DC array or damaged string wiring
Battery charge/discharge current surge
F20.recommended_action: Measure DC string operating currents using a DC clamp meter. Verify PV array module matching against inverter rating.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Switch off DC isolator and open string fuses.
Measure short-circuit current (Isc) and open-circuit voltage (Voc) of each string.

F22.title: Hardware Emergency Stop (TZ Fault)
F22.description: Inverter hardware protection circuit triggered an immediate emergency shutdown.
F22.oem_definition: TZ EmergStop Fault F22. Hardware trip-zone protection detected severe hardware anomaly or emergency stop trigger.
potential_causes: Inverter internal bridge driver fault or power stage failure
Severe external electrical transient on AC grid or DC bus
F22.recommended_action: Perform full power cycle of inverter. If fault persists on reboot, contact OEM support for main control board or power unit inspection.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Perform full power down: AC off, DC off, battery off. Wait 10 minutes and re-energize.

F23.title: AC Leakage Current Fault (GFCI)
F23.description: Residual ground leakage current exceeded safety threshold.
F23.oem_definition: GFCI Fault F23. Inverter residual current monitoring unit detected leakage current exceeding 300mA or sudden jump over 30mA.
potential_causes: Damaged PV cable insulation in contact with grounded metal frame
Moisture condensation in combiner boxes, MC4 connectors, or AC conduit
Module micro-cracks with moisture infiltration
Improper grounding bonding between AC neutral and earth
F23.recommended_action: Perform ground leakage and isolation tests across individual strings. Check moisture inside enclosures.

general_field_guidance.instruction: De-energize system. Do not touch exposed metal frames during active leakage alarm.
Disconnect strings one by one to isolate the branch causing leakage.

F24.title: DC Insulation Resistance Fault (ISO)
F24.description: PV array insulation resistance to earth ground is below the permissible limit.
F24.oem_definition: DC Insulation Fault F24. PV array insulation resistance to earth ground is lower than the safety threshold (typically < 100k ohm).
potential_causes: PV cable sheath pinched or worn against sharp racking edges
Water or condensation inside DC connector or junction box
Rodent damage to DC string wiring runs
F24.recommended_action: Use a 1000V DC insulation megohmmeter to test resistance of each string (positive to earth, negative to earth). Inspect wiring runs.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Disconnect string MC4 connectors from inverter. Megger test each string conductor to array ground.
Locate compromised cable section, replace connector/wire, and re-test for >1M ohm before reconnecting.

F26.title: DC Bus Unbalance Fault
F26.description: DC bus positive and negative half-voltages show abnormal imbalance.
F26.oem_definition: DC Bus Unbalance Fault F26. Internal DC bus capacitor split voltage difference exceeds permissible tolerance.
potential_causes: Degraded electrolytic DC bus capacitor
Severe neutral imbalance or AC grid harmonic distortion
Internal voltage sensing circuit drift
F26.recommended_action: Inspect grid neutral connection. If grid is balanced, internal inverter bus capacitors require OEM bench inspection.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check AC neutral connection and ground voltage at the inverter AC terminal block.

F29.title: Parallel CAN Communication Fault
F29.description: Communication link between parallel inverter units is interrupted.
F29.oem_definition: Parallel CAN Fault F29. CAN bus communication packet loss or timeout between master and slave inverters in a parallel cluster.
potential_causes: Loose or damaged RJ45 CAN parallel cable
Parallel termination dip switch set incorrectly on end unit
Master/slave parallel address conflict in system settings
F29.recommended_action: Check RJ45 parallel communication cables between inverters. Ensure termination resistors are enabled only on terminal inverters.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Reseat CAN cables. Verify DIP switch termination settings on first and last inverter.

F35.title: AC Grid Loss / No Utility (F35)
F35.description: Utility grid power is lost or AC circuit breaker is open.
F35.oem_definition: AC_NoUtillity_Fault F35. Inverter detected zero AC grid voltage on input lines. Grid outage or AC breaker opened.
potential_causes: DISCOM / Utility power outage or load shedding
AC main circuit breaker tripped or maintenance switch open
Loose AC input wire in external isolator or AC combiner box
F35.recommended_action: Verify utility grid presence at the AC distribution board. If grid is present, check AC breaker and isolator switches.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Confirm whether the local utility grid is active. Check site main incoming LT breaker.
Inverter will automatically synchronize and reconnect 60 seconds after grid voltage returns to normal range.

F41.title: Parallel System Phase Loss
F41.description: Phase sequence mismatch or missing phase in parallel inverter system.
F41.oem_definition: Parallel System Phase Fault F41. Parallel system detected phase sequence inconsistency across units.
potential_causes: Phase rotation reversed between master and slave inverters (L1/L2/L3 swapped)
Single-phase grid brownout or blown line fuse
F41.recommended_action: Check phase rotation with a phase indicator. Verify matching phase wiring across all parallel units.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check AC terminal sequence (R, S, T / L1, L2, L3) with a digital phase rotation meter.

F42.title: AC Grid Low Frequency
F42.description: Utility grid frequency dropped below inverter operating limits.
F42.oem_definition: AC Line Low Frequency F42. AC grid frequency is lower than the configured low-frequency trip threshold.
potential_causes: Grid overload or unstable local generator supply
Grid standard frequency setting parameter mismatch
F42.recommended_action: Monitor utility grid frequency. Auto-reconnects when frequency normalizes within standard grid limits (47.5 Hz - 50.2 Hz).

general_field_guidance.instruction: Verify generator or grid frequency. Inverter will reconnect automatically once frequency stabilizes.

F47.title: AC Grid High Frequency
F47.description: Utility grid frequency exceeded inverter operating limits.
F47.oem_definition: AC Grid Frequency High F47. AC grid frequency is higher than the configured over-frequency trip threshold.
potential_causes: Lightly loaded local grid or governor overshoot on backup diesel generator
Grid standard frequency parameter mismatch
F47.recommended_action: Monitor grid frequency. Reconnection occurs automatically after frequency stabilizes.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check generator governor or wait for utility grid stabilization.

F48.title: AC Grid Under-Voltage
F48.description: Utility grid voltage is below permissible lower operating limit.
F48.oem_definition: AC Grid Voltage Low F48. Utility line-to-neutral or line-to-line voltage dropped below low-voltage ride-through threshold.
potential_causes: Grid brownout or distant grid fault
High voltage drop along long or undersized AC cable run
Inadequate transformer tap setting at substation
F48.recommended_action: Measure line voltage at inverter AC terminals. Check AC cable sizing and transformer tap setting if brownout persists.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure RMS voltage on all AC phases at the inverter terminals. System auto-reconnects once grid voltage restores.

F49.title: AC Grid Over-Voltage
F49.description: Utility grid voltage exceeded upper permissible limit.
F49.oem_definition: AC Grid Voltage High F49. Utility grid voltage exceeded upper trip threshold.
potential_causes: High grid impedance combined with high solar export during peak sunshine
Utility distribution transformer tap set too high
Undersized AC cabling causing severe voltage rise between inverter and PCC
F49.recommended_action: Measure grid voltage under zero solar export and during full export. Consult utility for transformer tap adjustment if needed.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Record voltage rise across AC cable run. Inverter auto-reconnects when voltage returns within parameters.

F56.title: DC Bus Over-Voltage
F56.description: Inverter internal DC bus voltage exceeded upper hardware safety threshold.
F56.oem_definition: DC Busbar Voltage High F56. Internal DC bus capacitor voltage exceeded maximum safety limit.
potential_causes: PV string open circuit voltage (Voc) exceeded inverter maximum input rating under cold weather
Inverter internal boost circuit or voltage regulation fault
F56.recommended_action: Check PV string open-circuit voltage with a 1000V DC meter. Verify module temperature coefficients and string sizing.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure Voc of each PV string under full irradiance. Ensure Voc never exceeds maximum rated inverter voltage.

F58.title: BMS Communication Lost
F58.description: Communication link between inverter and Lithium battery BMS has timed out.
F58.oem_definition: BMS Communication Fault F58. Inverter CAN/RS485 communication with battery management system timed out or dropped.
potential_causes: Loose or disconnected RJ45 BMS communication cable
BMS protocol baud rate or address mismatch in inverter battery settings
Battery powered down or entered sleep mode
F58.recommended_action: Check RJ45 cable between inverter BMS port and battery. Verify battery protocol selection in system settings.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Reseat communication cable. Check battery power switch is ON and battery status LEDs show normal communication.

F63.title: DC Arc Fault Detected (AFCI)
F63.description: Arc-Fault Circuit Interrupter detected series or parallel arcing on DC array.
F63.oem_definition: ARC Fault F63. Inverter AFCI module detected electrical arcing signature in the DC circuit.
potential_causes: Loose or improperly crimped MC4 connector in PV string
Damaged or pinched DC cable conductor sparking against rail
Internal contact arcing in DC disconnect switch
F63.recommended_action: Thoroughly inspect all DC connectors, junction boxes, and module junction boxes on affected array. Clear fault only after verification.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Inspect all MC4 connections for signs of overheating, melting, or discoloration.
Per electrical safety standards, AFCI faults require physical inspection and manual acknowledgement before system clearing.

F64.title: Heat Sink Over-Temperature
F64.description: Internal power heatsink or IGBT temperature exceeded safe thermal threshold.
F64.oem_definition: Heatsink Over-temperature Fault F64. Thermal sensors on IGBT module or power transformer exceeded maximum operating temperature.
potential_causes: Inverter cooling fans blocked, failed, or air vents choked with dust
Direct sunlight exposure or ambient room temperature above 50°C
Inadequate clearance around inverter cooling heatsink
F64.recommended_action: Check cooling fans and clean heatsink air vents. Ensure adequate ventilation clearance around inverter enclosure.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Clean air filters and inspect external cooling fan operation. Inverter auto-reconnects once internal temperature drops below 65°C.

F25.title: DC Injection / Feedback Fault
F25.description: Direct current component injected into AC grid output exceeded permissible safety limits.
F25.oem_definition: DC_Feedback_Fault F25. Inverter current sensing circuit detected excessive DC component in AC output exceeding IEC/IEEE safety limits.
potential_causes: Internal current transducer sensing offset drift
Severe AC grid voltage waveform distortion or DC bias from external inductive loads
Inverter output filter stage degradation
F25.recommended_action: Perform complete inverter power cycle. If fault persists upon grid reconnection, contact OEM support for transducer calibration.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Switch off AC breaker, then DC isolator. Wait 5 minutes for bus capacitors to discharge. Power on DC first, then AC breaker.

F34.oem_code: F34 (AC Grid Voltage Out of Range)
F34.title: AC Grid Voltage Out of Range
F34.description: Utility grid voltage is outside the permissible operating window.
F34.oem_definition: AC_Grid_Voltage_Fault F34. Utility line voltage is higher or lower than the configured grid standard ride-through window.
potential_causes: Local utility grid fluctuation or line voltage sag/surge
High grid impedance during peak solar generation causing voltage rise
Utility distribution transformer tap setting mismatch
F34.recommended_action: Measure AC line-to-neutral and line-to-line RMS voltages at the inverter terminal block. Inverter auto-reconnects when voltage normalizes.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Verify grid voltage with a true-RMS multimeter. The inverter will automatically resume power generation within 60 seconds of grid normalization.
